data.name: NotOfficeDocument
data.value: The file is not a Word, Excel or PowerPoint document, is damaged or is protected with a password.

data.name: CsvIsBinary
data.value: The file is binary, not CSV text.

data.name: PdfEncrypted
data.value: The PDF is protected with a password.

data.name: NotPdf
data.value: The file is not a PDF, or it is damaged.

data.name: PdfCannotImport
data.value: Pages cannot be taken from this PDF.

data.name: NoPdfFonts
data.value: No Windows fonts with Cyrillic letters were found (Segoe UI, Arial or Tahoma): the PDF cannot be created.

data.name: UnsupportedFormat
data.value: '{0}' is not a supported document. Supported: {1}. Other files are read with read_file.

data.name: PathIsFolder
data.value: '{0}' is a folder, not a document.

data.name: FileNotWritable
data.value: '{0}' cannot be written: {1} The file may be open in Word or Excel — ask the user to close it.

data.name: PdfWithoutText
data.value: The PDF has no text layer: it looks like scanned images, and text recognition is not available.

data.name: MorePages
data.value: Shown pages {0} of {1}. Read the rest with pages: '{2}-'.

data.name: InvalidPages
data.value: Pages '{0}' are not valid: use '3', '2-5' or '1,4-6' within 1–{1}.

data.name: MoreRows
data.value: Shown {0} of {1} rows with data. Read the rest with range: '{2}'.

data.name: MoreColumns
data.value: Columns {0}–{1} are not shown: read them with range.

data.name: InvalidRange
data.value: Range '{0}' is not valid: use 'A1:F50', 'B:D' or '10:40'.

data.name: RangeHasNoData
data.value: Range '{0}' of sheet '{1}' has no data: the used range is {2}.

data.name: SheetNotFound
data.value: No sheet '{0}' in the workbook. Sheets: {1}.

data.name: NotWorksheet
data.value: '{0}' is a chart sheet, not a sheet with cells.

data.name: WrongFormatForAction
data.value: The {0} action works with {1} files, not '{2}'.

data.name: FileExists
data.value: '{0}' already exists. Change it with the editing actions, or set overwrite: true to replace it.

data.name: TextNotFound
data.value: Text '{0}' was not found in the document. Read the document and copy the text exactly, without Markdown marks; it must be within one paragraph.

data.name: TextFoundManyTimes
data.value: Text '{0}' occurs {1} times. Add neighbouring words to make it unique, or set all: true to replace every occurrence.

data.name: AnchorNotUnique
data.value: Text '{0}' occurs in more than one paragraph: add words to make it unique.

data.name: FormulaUnbalanced
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid formula: parentheses or quotes are not balanced. To write text that starts with '=', begin it with an apostrophe: '=text.

data.name: FormulaSemicolon
data.value: The formula '{0}' separates arguments with ';'. In the file formulas use commas and English function names: =SUM(A1,A2), =IF(B2>0,"yes","no").

data.name: FormulaLocalized
data.value: The formula '{0}' uses a localized function name. In the file functions are English: SUM, IF, VLOOKUP.

data.name: TableHeaderNotText
data.value: {0} is a column header of the table '{1}': only a non-empty text can be written there — it becomes the column name.

data.name: TableHeaderTaken
data.value: The table '{1}' already has a column '{0}': column names in a table must differ.

data.name: InvalidCellAddress
data.value: '{0}' is not a cell address: use A1, B12, AA3.

data.name: InvalidSheetName
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid sheet name: 1–{1} characters, without : \ / ? * [ ] and without an apostrophe at the start or end.

data.name: SheetExists
data.value: The workbook already has a sheet '{0}'.

data.name: NotPdfSource
data.value: '{0}' is not a PDF: only PDF pages can be joined.

data.name: TextReplaced
data.value: Replaced {0} time(s) in {1}; the formatting is kept.

data.name: FormulasRecalculated
data.value: Excel recalculates formulas when the file is opened; until then the document tool shows the values saved before.

data.name: SheetRenamed
data.value: Renamed sheet '{0}' to '{1}' in {2}; references to it in formulas, names and charts are updated.

data.name: PreviousInRecycleBin
data.value: The previous file is in the Recycle Bin.

data.name: PreviewNotShown
data.value: Nothing was changed: the confirmation card could not be prepared (the file may have been busy), so the user has not seen this change. Call again.

data.name: ChangedSincePreview
data.value: Nothing was changed: {0} changed after the user saw the confirmation card. Read it again and repeat the change.
